description.en-us: Adds the enter_plan_mode tool and reminds the agent to plan first for medium or complex tasks, delivering plan-mode guidance at the conversation tail so entering or leaving plan mode never rewrites the cached prompt prefix.
description.zh-cn: 提供 enter_plan_mode 工具，并在中等或复杂任务上提醒 Agent 先规划；计划模式指引搬到对话尾部，进入或退出计划模式都不再重写已缓存的提示词前缀。
description.en: Adds the enter_plan_mode tool and reminds the agent to plan first for medium or complex tasks, delivering plan-mode guidance at the conversation tail so entering or leaving plan mode never rewrites the cached prompt prefix.
description.zh: 提供 enter_plan_mode 工具，并在中等或复杂任务上提醒 Agent 先规划；计划模式指引搬到对话尾部，进入或退出计划模式都不再重写已缓存的提示词前缀。

description.en-us: Reviews and auto-approves command execution, adding an "Approve For Me" sandbox permission option
description.zh-cn: 审查并自动批准命令执行，新增「替我同意」沙箱权限选项
description.en: Reviews and auto-approves command execution, adding an "Approve For Me" sandbox permission option
description.zh: 审查并自动批准命令执行，新增「替我同意」沙箱权限选项

description.en-us: Auxiliary models for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 辅助模型插件
description.en: Auxiliary models for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 辅助模型插件

description.en-us: A VSCode-style right sidebar (explorer / editor / terminal / git / browser) built on the dshloader stable API
description.zh-cn: 基于 dshloader 稳定 API 的 VSCode 风格右侧边栏（资源管理器 / 编辑器 / 终端 / Git / 浏览器）
description.en: A VSCode-style right sidebar (explorer / editor / terminal / git / browser) built on the dshloader stable API
description.zh: 基于 dshloader 稳定 API 的 VSCode 风格右侧边栏（资源管理器 / 编辑器 / 终端 / Git / 浏览器）

description.en-us: Adds a dedicated Claude provider type with an Anthropic Messages form, a per-model adaptive thinking switch, thinking budgets for budget-driven models, and paginated Anthropic model discovery that fills recorded capacities for known Claude models.
description.zh-cn: 新增专用的 Claude 提供商类型，提供 Anthropic Messages 表单、逐模型自适应思考开关、预算思考模型的思考 token 预算，以及分页的 Anthropic 模型探测，并为已知 Claude 模型预填录制的容量参数。
description.en: Adds a dedicated Claude provider type with an Anthropic Messages form, a per-model adaptive thinking switch, thinking budgets for budget-driven models, and paginated Anthropic model discovery that fills recorded capacities for known Claude models.
description.zh: 新增专用的 Claude 提供商类型，提供 Anthropic Messages 表单、逐模型自适应思考开关、预算思考模型的思考 token 预算，以及分页的 Anthropic 模型探测，并为已知 Claude 模型预填录制的容量参数。

description.en-us: Codex-style per-turn code change summaries, review tab, and guarded undo for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh-cn: 逐轮代码变更摘要、审查标签页与受保护的撤销功能
description.en: Codex-style per-turn code change summaries, review tab, and guarded undo for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 逐轮代码变更摘要、审查标签页与受保护的撤销功能

description.en-us: Freezes the tool declaration list after a session's first step and delivers tools that appear later as trailing context, so a mid-conversation tool change no longer invalidates the cached prompt prefix.
description.zh-cn: 会话首步之后冻结请求中的工具声明列表，之后出现的工具以对话尾部消息下发，中途的工具变化不再让已缓存的提示词前缀失效。
description.en: Freezes the tool declaration list after a session's first step and delivers tools that appear later as trailing context, so a mid-conversation tool change no longer invalidates the cached prompt prefix.
description.zh: 会话首步之后冻结请求中的工具声明列表，之后出现的工具以对话尾部消息下发，中途的工具变化不再让已缓存的提示词前缀失效。

description.en-us: Require the model to read an eligible skill before using other tools. Successful reads apply to the current session until context compaction.
description.zh-cn: 要求模型先读取符合配置的 SKILL，再使用其他工具。已读状态在当前会话内持续至下一次成功的上下文压缩。
description.en: Require the model to read an eligible skill before using other tools. Successful reads apply to the current session until context compaction.
description.zh: 要求模型先读取符合配置的 SKILL，再使用其他工具。已读状态在当前会话内持续至下一次成功的上下文压缩。

description.en-us: Browse every task of the current Gradle project in the DSH right Sidebar, grouped into folders by the group each task declares; double-click one to run it with the project wrapper and a chosen JDK, with the build output streamed back into the panel terminal.
description.zh-cn: 在 DSH 右侧边栏浏览当前 Gradle 项目的全部任务，按声明的 group 分文件夹展示；双击任务即可用项目 wrapper 和选定的 JDK 运行，输出实时回传到面板终端。
description.en: Browse every task of the current Gradle project in the DSH right Sidebar, grouped into folders by the group each task declares; double-click one to run it with the project wrapper and a chosen JDK, with the build output streamed back into the panel terminal.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏浏览当前 Gradle 项目的全部任务，按声明的 group 分文件夹展示；双击任务即可用项目 wrapper 和选定的 JDK 运行，输出实时回传到面板终端。

description.en-us: A version-aware runtime compatibility shim that keeps third-party plugins working unchanged across dsh upgrades
description.zh-cn: 版本感知的运行时兼容层，让第三方插件在 dsh 升级后无需修改即可继续工作
description.en: A version-aware runtime compatibility shim that keeps third-party plugins working unchanged across dsh upgrades
description.zh: 版本感知的运行时兼容层，让第三方插件在 dsh 升级后无需修改即可继续工作

description.en-us: Derive custom Agent modes from Standard, Minimal, PTC, Creator, or any existing mode in the plugin settings page: pick the tools and SKILL a mode keeps, then choose the new mode when starting a session.
description.zh-cn: 在插件配置页从标准、极简、PTC、创造或任意既有模式派生自定义 Agent 模式：勾选要保留的工具与 SKILL，新建会话时直接选用。
description.en: Derive custom Agent modes from Standard, Minimal, PTC, Creator, or any existing mode in the plugin settings page: pick the tools and SKILL a mode keeps, then choose the new mode when starting a session.
description.zh: 在插件配置页从标准、极简、PTC、创造或任意既有模式派生自定义 Agent 模式：勾选要保留的工具与 SKILL，新建会话时直接选用。

description.en-us: Matches prompt files against the current model and injects their guidance into the system prompt, replacing the prompt head when the model changes.
description.zh-cn: 按当前模型匹配提示词文件并向系统提示词注入专用指导，切换模型时替换头部而不是追加过期内容。
description.en: Matches prompt files against the current model and injects their guidance into the system prompt, replacing the prompt head when the model changes.
description.zh: 按当前模型匹配提示词文件并向系统提示词注入专用指导，切换模型时替换头部而不是追加过期内容。

description.en-us: User-Agent rewriting, HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy, and request retries. The next channel adds configurable response idle timeouts for HTTP and pi-ai.
description.zh-cn: 支持 User-Agent 改写、HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理和请求重试。开发版新增可配置的 HTTP 与 pi-ai 响应空闲超时。
description.en: User-Agent rewriting, HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy, and request retries. The next channel adds configurable response idle timeouts for HTTP and pi-ai.
description.zh: 支持 User-Agent 改写、HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理和请求重试。开发版新增可配置的 HTTP 与 pi-ai 响应空闲超时。

description.en-us: Assemble each session's system prompt and tool whitelist from the YAML frontmatter of AGENTS.md and SKILL.md, a bound custom mode, and live runtime probes. Pinned rules are never truncated, scoped rules are budgeted by byte size, and a per-session guard rejects tools outside the whitelist.
description.zh-cn: 按 AGENTS.md / SKILL.md 的 YAML 头部规则、已绑定的自定义模式与运行时探测，为每个会话动态拼装系统提示词与工具白名单：pinned 规则固顶不截断，scoped 规则按字节预算裁剪，白名单外的工具由会话守卫拒绝。
description.en: Assemble each session's system prompt and tool whitelist from the YAML frontmatter of AGENTS.md and SKILL.md, a bound custom mode, and live runtime probes. Pinned rules are never truncated, scoped rules are budgeted by byte size, and a per-session guard rejects tools outside the whitelist.
description.zh: 按 AGENTS.md / SKILL.md 的 YAML 头部规则、已绑定的自定义模式与运行时探测，为每个会话动态拼装系统提示词与工具白名单：pinned 规则固顶不截断，scoped 规则按字节预算裁剪，白名单外的工具由会话守卫拒绝。

description.en-us: Tree-structured conversations for the official DSH chat: switch message branches, edit user messages in place, recall pending or sent input, and retry assistant replies. Stores the complete tree separately and exports the active path in the official session format.
description.zh-cn: 为官方 DSH 聊天提供树状会话：切换消息分支、原位编辑用户消息、撤回答复和待发送输入、重试助手回复。完整树独立保存，激活路径以官方会话格式导出。
description.en: Tree-structured conversations for the official DSH chat: switch message branches, edit user messages in place, recall pending or sent input, and retry assistant replies. Stores the complete tree separately and exports the active path in the official session format.
description.zh: 为官方 DSH 聊天提供树状会话：切换消息分支、原位编辑用户消息、撤回答复和待发送输入、重试助手回复。完整树独立保存，激活路径以官方会话格式导出。

description.en-us: Choose the shell every agent command runs in — PowerShell, cmd, Git Bash, WSL, bash, zsh, fish or sh — with discovery, an explicit path override, per-shell status facts, a fixed self-test, and a refusal before any process exists when the selected shell cannot be confined.
description.zh-cn: 选择每个智能体命令运行所用的 Shell——PowerShell、cmd、Git Bash、WSL、bash、zsh、fish 或 sh；支持自动探测、显式路径覆盖、逐 Shell 状态事实、固定自检，并在所选 Shell 无法被沙箱限制时于任何进程创建前拒绝执行。
description.en: Choose the shell every agent command runs in — PowerShell, cmd, Git Bash, WSL, bash, zsh, fish or sh — with discovery, an explicit path override, per-shell status facts, a fixed self-test, and a refusal before any process exists when the selected shell cannot be confined.
description.zh: 选择每个智能体命令运行所用的 Shell——PowerShell、cmd、Git Bash、WSL、bash、zsh、fish 或 sh；支持自动探测、显式路径覆盖、逐 Shell 状态事实、固定自检，并在所选 Shell 无法被沙箱限制时于任何进程创建前拒绝执行。

description.en-us: Turns off browser spellcheck for every text input in the DSH Web UI, removing the red squiggles shown while typing Chinese, code, and proper nouns.
description.zh-cn: 关闭 DSH Web 界面所有文本输入框的浏览器原生拼写检查，消除输入中文、代码、专有名词时出现的红色波浪下划线。
description.en: Turns off browser spellcheck for every text input in the DSH Web UI, removing the red squiggles shown while typing Chinese, code, and proper nouns.
description.zh: 关闭 DSH Web 界面所有文本输入框的浏览器原生拼写检查，消除输入中文、代码、专有名词时出现的红色波浪下划线。

description.en-us: Registers subagent_status to inspect a subagent's work digest, context occupancy and model route, and subagent_control to compact, re-route, interrupt or wake it.
description.zh-cn: 注册 subagent_status 观测子代理的工作摘要、上下文占用与模型路由，注册 subagent_control 对其执行压缩、切换模型、中断与唤醒。
description.en: Registers subagent_status to inspect a subagent's work digest, context occupancy and model route, and subagent_control to compact, re-route, interrupt or wake it.
description.zh: 注册 subagent_status 观测子代理的工作摘要、上下文占用与模型路由，注册 subagent_control 对其执行压缩、切换模型、中断与唤醒。

description.en-us: Injects a configurable introduction of subagent models right before the subagent tool description, so the model knows what each subagent model is good at before delegating.
description.zh-cn: 在子代理工具说明之前注入可配置的子代理模型介绍，让模型在委派前就知道每个子代理模型擅长什么、适合在什么场景使用。
description.en: Injects a configurable introduction of subagent models right before the subagent tool description, so the model knows what each subagent model is good at before delegating.
description.zh: 在子代理工具说明之前注入可配置的子代理模型介绍，让模型在委派前就知道每个子代理模型擅长什么、适合在什么场景使用。

description.en-us: QQ and Discord chat bridging, GitHub PR/Issue review, local hybrid memory and Skill management powered by persistent DSH sessions
description.zh-cn: 基于 DSH 驻留会话的 QQ 与 Discord 聊天桥接、GitHub PR/Issue 审查、本地混合记忆及 Skill 管理
description.en: QQ and Discord chat bridging, GitHub PR/Issue review, local hybrid memory and Skill management powered by persistent DSH sessions
description.zh: 基于 DSH 驻留会话的 QQ 与 Discord 聊天桥接、GitHub PR/Issue 审查、本地混合记忆及 Skill 管理

description.en-us: A dynamic little avatar animation before the DeepSeek Harness "deep diving" state — GrokBot-style SVG animation or emoji carousel
description.zh-cn: 在「Deep diving…」状态前插入动态小表情头像——GrokBot 风格 SVG 动画或 emoji 轮播
description.en: A dynamic little avatar animation before the DeepSeek Harness "deep diving" state — GrokBot-style SVG animation or emoji carousel
description.zh: 在「Deep diving…」状态前插入动态小表情头像——GrokBot 风格 SVG 动画或 emoji 轮播

description.en-us: Makes the interface follow the Material You palette matugen generates on the system and unifies the interface border width, both toggled from a settings row.
description.zh-cn: 让界面跟随系统 matugen 生成的 Material You 配色，并统一界面边框宽度，均可在设置行内开关。
description.en: Makes the interface follow the Material You palette matugen generates on the system and unifies the interface border width, both toggled from a settings row.
description.zh: 让界面跟随系统 matugen 生成的 Material You 配色，并统一界面边框宽度，均可在设置行内开关。

description.en-us: Local browser tools browser_web_search and browser_web_fetch with validated search results, text or Markdown extraction, and optional persistent browser sessions.
description.zh-cn: 通过本机浏览器提供 browser_web_search 和 browser_web_fetch，支持搜索结果校验、纯文本或 Markdown 提取，以及可选的持久化浏览器会话。
description.en: Local browser tools browser_web_search and browser_web_fetch with validated search results, text or Markdown extraction, and optional persistent browser sessions.
description.zh: 通过本机浏览器提供 browser_web_search 和 browser_web_fetch，支持搜索结果校验、纯文本或 Markdown 提取，以及可选的持久化浏览器会话。
